standards.text: The learners demonstrate understanding of principles on the overview of agricultural crops production, farm tools, implements, and simple equipment, and pre-operative check-up following the manufacturer’s manual.
The learners perform pre-operative checking of tools, farm implements, and equipment in accordance with the manufacturer’s manual.
The learners demonstrate understanding of kinds and varieties of planting materials and characteristics of good planting materials.
The learners perform growing media preparation, nursery operations, and planting of crops based on industry practices and Philippine Good Agricultural Practices.
The learners demonstrate understanding on irrigation system, fertilizer application, and pests and diseases management in crops production.
The learners perform fertilization and pest control in crops production based on Good Agricultural Practices (GAP).
The learners demonstrate understanding of the principles in harvesting crops according to industry practices.
The learners perform harvesting and post-harvesting operation according to industry practices and selling of produced crops in the locality.
